literal: Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery Chen; his son Rui; Prince Yue of Qinghe Yue; his son Mai
idiomatic: Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery (Gao Chen); his son Rui (Gao Rui); Prince Yue of Qinghe (Gao Yue); his son Mai (Gao Mai)

literal: Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery, styled Yongbao, was a younger brother of the Grand Ancestor.
idiomatic: Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery, styled Yongbao, was a younger brother of Gao Huan.

literal: In youth he was skilled at archery and horsemanship, and possessed ambition and spirit.
idiomatic: In youth he was skilled at archery and horsemanship, and possessed ambition and spirit.

literal: After the Grand Ancestor had set the realm right, at the beginning of the Restoration he was appointed Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, General Who Pacifies the West, and Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
idiomatic: After Gao Huan had set the realm right, at the beginning of the Restoration he was appointed regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, general who pacifies the west, and grand master of the golden seal and purple ribbon.

literal: Once he held palace guard duty, he was reverent, diligent, and discreet, taking the lead among those at the emperor's side.
idiomatic: Once he held palace guard duty, he was reverent, diligent, and discreet, taking the lead among those at the emperor's side.

literal: At the beginning of Taichang, he was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, Left Grand Master of the Golden Seal, enfeoffed Duke of Southern Zhao Commandery with a fief of five thousand households.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Taichang, he was made general of chariots and cavalry, left grand master of the golden seal, and enfeoffed duke of Southern Zhao Commandery with a fief of five thousand households.

literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, Special Advance, Opener of a Government Office Equal in Protocol to Three Imperators, and Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry.
idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed grand general of the agile cavalry, special advance, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, and regular attendant of the scattered cavalry.

literal: In the second year of Yongxi, he was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Area Commander of Ding Province, and Area Commander-in-Chief of Six Provinces.
idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi, he was made bearer of the staff of authority, area commander of Ding Province, and area commander-in-chief of six provinces.

literal: Chen treated people with sincerity and kindness, promoted men of talent, and enjoyed a very fine reputation.
idiomatic: Chen treated people with sincerity and kindness, promoted men of talent, and enjoyed a very fine reputation.

literal: When Hu Sisun and others formed a conspiracy.
idiomatic: When Hu Sisun and others formed a conspiracy.

literal: The Grand Ancestor planned an internal punitive campaign; because Jinyang was the foundation of his power, he summoned Chen to remain and manage affairs in the rear, appointing him Vice Director of the Great Eastern Headquarters for Bing, Xi, and Fen, and Area Commander-in-Chief of the Six Provinces and Nine Chieftains — Chen decided all affairs of the chancellor's office.
idiomatic: Gao Huan planned an internal punitive campaign; because Jinyang was the foundation of his power, he summoned Chen to remain and manage affairs in the rear, appointing him vice director of the great eastern headquarters for Bing, Xi, and Fen, and area commander-in-chief of the six provinces and nine chieftains — Chen decided all affairs of the chancellor's office.

literal: In the Tianping era he was made Censor-in-Chief; with stern countenance he investigated and impeached, never shrinking from anyone, and near and far were awed into order.
idiomatic: In the Tianping era he was made censor-in-chief; with stern countenance he investigated and impeached, never shrinking from anyone, and near and far were awed into order.

literal: Soon he violated the Grand Ancestor's rear palaces; the Grand Ancestor rebuked and punished him, and he was beaten to death with a staff — he was twenty-three.
idiomatic: Soon he violated Gao Huan's rear palaces; Gao Huan rebuked and punished him, and he was beaten to death with a staff — he was twenty-three.

literal: Posthumously he was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, Area Commander of Military Affairs in ten provinces — Ji, Ding, Cang, Ying, You, Yin, Bing, Xi, Yun, and Shuo — Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, Governor of Ji Province, Grand Commandant, and Director of the Masters of Writing; his posthumous title was Zhenping.
idiomatic: Posthumously he was appointed bearer of the staff of authority, palace attendant, area commander of military affairs in ten provinces — Ji, Ding, Cang, Ying, You, Yin, Bing, Xi, Yun, and Shuo — grand general of the agile cavalry, governor of Ji Province, grand commandant, and director of the masters of writing; his posthumous title was Zhenping.

literal: In the third year of Tiantong he was further posthumously granted the Yellow Battle-Axe, Left Chancellor, Grand Preceptor, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Ji Province; his rank was advanced to prince, and he was granted sacrifice in the Grand Ancestor's temple hall.
idiomatic: In the third year of Tiantong he was further posthumously granted the yellow battle-axe, left chancellor, grand preceptor, recorder of affairs of the masters of writing, and governor of Ji Province; his rank was advanced to prince, and he was granted sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple hall.

literal: His son Rui succeeded.
idiomatic: His son Rui succeeded.

literal: Rui's childhood name was Xuba; he was orphaned at thirty days, precocious and clever from infancy, and was especially loved by the Grand Ancestor; he was raised in the palace and entrusted to Youniang as foster mother, receiving favor equal to the other sons.
idiomatic: Rui's childhood name was Xuba; he was orphaned at thirty days, precocious and clever from infancy, and was especially loved by Gao Huan; he was raised in the palace and entrusted to Youniang as foster mother, receiving favor equal to the other sons.

literal: In the Xinghe era of Wei, he inherited the title Duke of Southern Zhao Commandery.
idiomatic: In the Xinghe era of Wei, he inherited the title duke of Southern Zhao Commandery.

literal: By the age of four he had never known his mother — his mother was the Princess Huayang of Wei.
idiomatic: By the age of four he had never known his mother — his mother was the Princess Huayang of Wei.

literal: There was a Lady Zheng, daughter of a maternal cousin of Rui's mother, who playfully said to Rui, "You are my cousin's child — why do you instead show affection for the You clan?
idiomatic: There was a Lady Zheng, daughter of a maternal cousin of Rui's mother, who playfully said to Rui, "You are my cousin's child — why do you instead show affection for the You clan?

literal: " Rui thereupon made inquiries, and his spirits grew troubled.
idiomatic: " Rui thereupon made inquiries, and his spirits grew troubled.

literal: The Grand Ancestor thought it very strange, suspected he had fallen ill, and wished to summon a physician to examine him.
idiomatic: Gao Huan thought it very strange, suspected he had fallen ill, and wished to summon a physician to examine him.

literal: Rui replied, "Your son has no illness or pain — I only heard that I have a birth mother, and wish to see her for a time.
idiomatic: Rui replied, "Your son has no illness or pain — I only heard that I have a birth mother, and wish to see her for a time.

literal: " The Grand Ancestor said in astonishment, "Who told you this?
idiomatic: " Gao Huan said in astonishment, "Who told you this?

literal: " Rui fully explained the sequence of events.
idiomatic: " Rui fully explained the sequence of events.

literal: The Grand Ancestor ordered Lady Yuan to come to the palace and meet Rui; Rui went forward, knelt and bowed, then embraced her head and wept loudly.
idiomatic: Gao Huan ordered Lady Yuan to come to the palace and meet Rui; Rui went forward, knelt and bowed, then embraced her head and wept loudly.

literal: The Grand Ancestor was deeply grieved.
idiomatic: Gao Huan was deeply grieved.

literal: He said to the Prince of Pingqin, "This child is filial by nature — none of my sons can match him.
idiomatic: He said to Prince of Pingqin Guiyan, "This child is filial by nature — none of my sons can match him.

literal: " Thereupon he suspended official business for one day.
idiomatic: " Thereupon he suspended official business for one day.

literal: When Rui first read the Classic of Filial Piety, upon reaching "drawing upon in serving one's father" he would weep and sigh.
idiomatic: When Rui first read the Classic of Filial Piety, upon reaching "drawing upon in serving one's father" he would weep and sigh.

literal: At ten he lost his mother; the Grand Ancestor personally escorted Rui to the Commandant's headquarters, held mourning for him, and wailed until his voice failed — his grief moved those around him, and for three days he took neither water nor food.
idiomatic: At ten he lost his mother; Gao Huan personally escorted Rui to the commandant's headquarters, held mourning for him, and wailed until his voice failed — his grief moved those around him, and for three days he took neither water nor food.

literal: The Grand Ancestor and Empress Wuming of the Lou clan earnestly urged and admonished him, and only then did he gradually comply.
idiomatic: Gao Huan and Empress Lou Wuming earnestly urged and admonished him, and only then did he gradually comply.

literal: In mourning he observed every rite, kept a long fast before a Buddha image until he was wasted to the bone, and only rose with the aid of a staff.
idiomatic: In mourning he observed every rite, kept a long fast before a Buddha image until he was wasted to the bone, and only rose with the aid of a staff.

literal: The Grand Ancestor had the Prince of Changshan share bed and board with him, exhorting him day and night.
idiomatic: Gao Huan had Prince of Changshan Gao Yan share bed and board with him, exhorting him day and night.

literal: He also ordered those at his side not to allow water to be brought in; though he cut off even rinsing his mouth, after noon he still refused food.
idiomatic: He also ordered those at his side not to allow water to be brought in; though he cut off even rinsing his mouth, after noon he still refused food.

literal: From this the Grand Ancestor always summoned Rui to share his table at meals.
idiomatic: From this Gao Huan always summoned Rui to share his table at meals.

literal: Such was the pity and tenderness shown him.
idiomatic: Such was the pity and tenderness shown him.

literal: When the Grand Ancestor died, Rui wept until he vomited blood.
idiomatic: When Gao Huan died, Rui wept until he vomited blood.

literal: When he came of age and was to marry, his countenance still bore sorrow.
idiomatic: When he came of age and was to marry, his countenance still bore sorrow.

literal: The Imperial Founder said to him, "I will marry you to the daughter of Zheng Shuzu — her family standing is very high; what do you find objectionable, that your spirits are not glad?
idiomatic: Gao Cheng said to him, "I will marry you to the daughter of Zheng Shuzu — her family standing is very high; what do you find objectionable, that your spirits are not glad?

literal: " Rui replied, "Since I was orphaned early, I have always deeply yearned for the warmth beneath my parents' knees; now, on the eve of cap and marriage, I feel this all the more keenly.
idiomatic: " Rui replied, "Since I was orphaned early, I have always deeply yearned for the warmth beneath my parents' knees; now, on the eve of cap and marriage, I feel this all the more keenly.

literal: " Before he finished speaking, he sobbed uncontrollably.
idiomatic: " Before he finished speaking, he sobbed uncontrollably.

literal: The Imperial Founder was moved to pity and fell silent.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng was moved to pity and fell silent.

literal: He disciplined himself in study, often reading late into the night before stopping.
idiomatic: He disciplined himself in study, often reading late into the night before stopping.

literal: At the end of Wuding he was made Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.
idiomatic: At the end of Wuding he was made junior tutor to the crown prince.

literal: When the Manifest Ancestor received the abdication, Rui's enfeoffment was advanced to Prince of Zhao Commandery with a fief of twelve hundred households, and he was transferred to Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry.
idiomatic: When Gao Yang received the abdication, Rui's enfeoffment was advanced to prince of Zhao Commandery with a fief of twelve hundred households, and he was transferred to regular attendant of the scattered cavalry.

literal: Rui stood seven feet in height, his bearing very imposing; he was versed in administrative duties and possessed a discerning eye for men.
idiomatic: Rui stood seven feet in height, his bearing very imposing; he was versed in administrative duties and possessed a discerning eye for men.

literal: In the second year he went out as Governor of Ding Province, with the additional titles General Who Pacifies the Army and Area Commander-in-Chief of Six Provinces — he was seventeen.
idiomatic: In the second year he went out as governor of Ding Province, with the additional titles general who pacifies the army and area commander-in-chief of six provinces — he was seventeen.

literal: Rui attended to all manner of affairs, investigated and exposed wrongdoing, encouraged agriculture and sericulture, received worthy commoners with courtesy, and his jurisdiction was greatly governed — he was called an excellent governor.
idiomatic: Rui attended to all manner of affairs, investigated and exposed wrongdoing, encouraged agriculture and sericulture, received worthy commoners with courtesy, and his jurisdiction was greatly governed — he was called an excellent governor.

literal: In the third year he was given the additional title Equal in Protocol to Three Imperators.
idiomatic: In the third year he was given the additional title equal in protocol to three imperators.

literal: In the sixth year an edict ordered Rui to lead tens of thousands of eastern troops to supervise construction of the Long Wall.
idiomatic: In the sixth year an edict ordered Rui to lead tens of thousands of eastern troops to supervise construction of the Long Wall.

literal: At that time it was the height of summer in the sixth month; Rui was on the road, set aside parasols and fans, and personally shared the labor and hardship with the soldiers.
idiomatic: At that time it was the height of summer in the sixth month; Rui was on the road, set aside parasols and fans, and personally shared the labor and hardship with the soldiers.

literal: Ding Province had formerly possessed an ice house; each year ice was stored, and the Chief Administrator Song Qindao, because Rui was braving the summer heat, sent a carriage of ice after him at double speed.
idiomatic: Ding Province had formerly possessed an ice house; each year ice was stored, and the chief administrator Song Qindao, because Rui was braving the summer heat, sent a carriage of ice after him at double speed.

literal: It happened to be midday when they halted; the blazing heat was especially fierce and no one could bear it — when the ice arrived, all said that obtaining ice was the need of the moment.
idiomatic: It happened to be midday when they halted; the blazing heat was especially fierce and no one could bear it — when the ice arrived, all said that obtaining ice was the need of the moment.

literal: Rui sighed in response, saying, "The troops all drink warm water — on what grounds should I alone take cold ice? It is not to chase the fame of ancient generals; truly my heart cannot bear it.
idiomatic: Rui sighed in response, saying, "The troops all drink warm water — on what grounds should I alone take cold ice? It is not to chase the fame of ancient generals; truly my heart cannot bear it.

literal: " He let it melt away completely and never tasted it once.
idiomatic: " He let it melt away completely and never tasted it once.

literal: The soldiers were moved and delighted; near and far praised and marveled.
idiomatic: The soldiers were moved and delighted; near and far praised and marveled.

literal: Previously, when corvée labor finished work, the laborers were allowed to return on their own.
idiomatic: Previously, when corvée labor finished work, the laborers were allowed to return on their own.

literal: The strong and able went home first;
idiomatic: The strong and able went home first;

literal: the weak and frail were abandoned north of the mountains, and with hunger and sickness added, many collapsed and died.
idiomatic: the weak and frail were abandoned north of the mountains, and with hunger and sickness added, many collapsed and died.

literal: Rui thereupon personally led his command and returned together with them, assigning them to their districts and townships, organizing them into companies and squads, with overseers supervising — strong and weak supporting one another; wherever good grass and water were found they halted; surplus was divided and deficiency supplied — of those who encamped along the way, roughly three or four out of ten were preserved intact.
idiomatic: Rui thereupon personally led his command and returned together with them, assigning them to their districts and townships, organizing them into companies and squads, with overseers supervising — strong and weak supporting one another; wherever good grass and water were found they halted; surplus was divided and deficiency supplied — of those who encamped along the way, roughly three or four out of ten were preserved intact.

literal: In the seventh year an edict made him, in his existing office, Area Commander of Military Affairs in six provinces — Cang, Ying, You, An, Ping, and Dongyan — and Governor of Cang Province.
idiomatic: In the seventh year an edict made him, in his existing office, area commander of military affairs in six provinces — Cang, Ying, You, An, Ping, and Dongyan — and governor of Cang Province.

literal: In the eighth year Rui was summoned to Ye and was made Governor of Beishuo Province, Area Commander of Beiyan, Beiwei, and Beiheng, and of the garrison towns along the Long Wall west of Kutui and east of the Yellow River.
idiomatic: In the eighth year Rui was summoned to Ye and was made governor of Beishuo Province, area commander of Beiyan, Beiwei, and Beiheng, and of the garrison towns along the Long Wall west of Kutui and east of the Yellow River.

literal: Rui comforted and settled the newly relocated population, measured out beacon towers and garrisons, defended within and guarded without — regulations were complete in every detail, and soldiers and civilians were greatly reassured.
idiomatic: Rui comforted and settled the newly relocated population, measured out beacon towers and garrisons, defended within and guarded without — regulations were complete in every detail, and soldiers and civilians were greatly reassured.

literal: Where there was no water, he prayed and dug a well; as soon as the spade and hoe were lowered, a spring gushed forth — to this day it is called the Prince of Zhao Commandery Spring.
idiomatic: Where there was no water, he prayed and dug a well; as soon as the spade and hoe were lowered, a spring gushed forth — to this day it is called the Prince of Zhao Commandery Spring.

literal: In the ninth year the imperial carriage visited Loufan; Rui attended audience at the traveling palace and returned with the emperor to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the ninth year the imperial carriage visited Loufan; Rui attended audience at the traveling palace and returned with the emperor to Jinyang.

literal: At that time the Prince of Ji'nan, as crown prince, supervised the state; a Great Area Commander's Office was therefore established to divide affairs with the Masters of Writing, and a government office with staff was opened.
idiomatic: At that time the Prince of Ji'nan, as crown prince, supervised the state; a great area commander's office was therefore established to divide affairs with the masters of writing, and a government office with staff was opened.

literal: The Manifest Ancestor especially honored the selection and made Rui Palace Attendant and Acting Chief Administrator of the Great Area Commander's Office.
idiomatic: Gao Yang especially honored the selection and made Rui palace attendant and acting chief administrator of the great area commander's office.

literal: Later, while attending a banquet, the Manifest Ancestor casually turned to the Prince of Changshan Yan and others and said, "Has there ever been a chief administrator like this?
idiomatic: Later, while attending a banquet, Gao Yang casually turned to Prince of Changshan Gao Yan and others and said, "Has there ever been a chief administrator like this?

literal: What do you think of my using this chief administrator?
idiomatic: What do you think of my using this chief administrator?

literal: " Yan replied, "Your Majesty attends to the myriad affairs of government with care, honors the worthy and treats them with courtesy — at promotion one should occupy the glory of the cicada ear ornament; at retirement one should hold weighty posts of trust. From antiquity until now, truly none has heard of such an appointment.
idiomatic: " Yan replied, "Your Majesty attends to the myriad affairs of government with care, honors the worthy and treats them with courtesy — at promotion one should occupy the glory of the cicada ear ornament; at retirement one should hold weighty posts of trust. From antiquity until now, truly none has heard of such an appointment.

literal: " The emperor said, "In this too I consider myself to have hit the mark.
idiomatic: " The emperor said, "In this too I consider myself to have hit the mark.

literal: " In the tenth year he was transferred to Equal in Protocol to Three Imperators, Palace Attendant, General, and Chief Administrator — his princely title unchanged.
idiomatic: " In the tenth year he was transferred to equal in protocol to three imperators, palace attendant, general, and chief administrator — his princely title unchanged.

literal: Soon afterward he was given the additional titles Opener of a Government Office Equal in Protocol to Three Imperators, Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, and Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince.
idiomatic: Soon afterward he was given the additional titles opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, grand general of the agile cavalry, and grand preceptor to the crown prince.

literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he acted as Administrator of Bing Province.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Huangjian he acted as administrator of Bing Province.

literal: When Xiaozhao faced death he received the imperial testament in advance, welcomed the Imperial Ancestor at Ye, and for his service was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; he was separately enfeoffed Duke of Fuyang Commandery, made Supervisor of the Grand Astrologer, Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince, and charged with deliberating on the code of laws.
idiomatic: When Gao Yan faced death he received the imperial testament in advance, welcomed Gao Zhan at Ye, and for his service was appointed director of the masters of writing; he was separately enfeoffed duke of Fuyang Commandery, made supervisor of the grand astrologer, grand preceptor to the crown prince, and charged with deliberating on the code of laws.

literal: For merit in campaigning against the northern barbarians he was also enfeoffed Duke of Yingchuan Commandery.
idiomatic: For merit in campaigning against the northern barbarians he was also enfeoffed duke of Yingchuan Commandery.

literal: He was again appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and Acting Director of the Grand Clan Court.
idiomatic: He was again appointed director of the masters of writing and acting director of the grand clan court.

literal: In the Tiantong era Rui's father Chen was posthumously granted the Yellow Battle-Axe; his mother the Yuan clan was posthumously made Princess of Zhao Commandery with the posthumous title Zhenzhao — her title Princess Huayang remained unchanged — and the relevant offices prepared the rites and went to the tomb to invest her by proclamation.
idiomatic: In the Tiantong era Rui's father Chen was posthumously granted the yellow battle-axe; his mother the Yuan clan was posthumously made princess of Zhao Commandery with the posthumous title Zhenzhao — her title Princess Huayang remained unchanged — and the relevant offices prepared the rites and went to the tomb to invest her by proclamation.

literal: It was deep winter and bitterly cold; Rui walked barefoot, wailing and crying until his face split open, and he vomited several sheng of blood.
idiomatic: It was deep winter and bitterly cold; Rui walked barefoot, wailing and crying until his face split open, and he vomited several sheng of blood.

literal: When he returned he could not bear to attend court in audience; the emperor personally visited his residence to inquire after him.
idiomatic: When he returned he could not bear to attend court in audience; the emperor personally visited his residence to inquire after him.

literal: He was appointed Minister of Works and Acting Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: He was appointed minister of works and acting recorder of affairs of the masters of writing.

literal: The Turks once raided as far as Bing Province; the emperor personally took the field, and the advance and halt of the six armies all followed Rui's command.
idiomatic: The Turks once raided as far as Bing Province; the emperor personally took the field, and the advance and halt of the six armies all followed Rui's command.

literal: For his merit he was again enfeoffed Duke of Xuancheng Commandery.
idiomatic: For his merit he was again enfeoffed duke of Xuancheng Commandery.

literal: Acting Director of the Grand Clan Court, he was promoted to Grand Commandant and made Supervisor of the deliberation on the Five Rites.
idiomatic: Acting director of the grand clan court, he was promoted to grand commandant and made supervisor of the deliberation on the five rites.

literal: Rui had long managed court politics, kept himself pure and upright, and his reputation rose day by day; he was gradually viewed with distant suspicion, and so he compiled ancient loyal ministers and righteous men in a work called Essential Words to express his intent.
idiomatic: Rui had long managed court politics, kept himself pure and upright, and his reputation rose day by day; he was gradually viewed with distant suspicion, and so he compiled ancient loyal ministers and righteous men in a work called Essential Words to express his intent.

literal: When the Imperial Ancestor died, several days after the burial Rui, together with the Prince of Fenyang Run, the Prince of Ande Yanzong, and Yuan Wenyao, memorialized the Last Emperor, saying, "He Shikai should not continue to hold an inner appointment.
idiomatic: When Gao Zhan died, several days after the burial Rui, together with Prince of Fenyang Gao Run, Prince of Ande Gao Yanzong, and Yuan Wenyao, memorialized the Last Emperor, saying, "He Shikai should not continue to hold an inner appointment.

literal: " They all entered to memorialize the empress dowager, and He Shikai was sent out as Governor of Yan Province.
idiomatic: " They all entered to memorialize the empress dowager, and He Shikai was sent out as governor of Yan Province.

literal: The empress dowager said, "Shikai has long served at my command — I wish to keep him for a hundred days more.
idiomatic: The empress dowager said, "Shikai has long served at my command — I wish to keep him for a hundred days more.

literal: " Rui with stern countenance would not permit it.
idiomatic: " Rui with stern countenance would not permit it.

literal: Within a few days the empress dowager repeatedly spoke on his behalf.
idiomatic: Within a few days the empress dowager repeatedly spoke on his behalf.

literal: A favored eunuch who knew the empress dowager's secret intent said to Rui, "Since the empress dowager's wish is already thus, why should Your Highness stubbornly oppose it?
idiomatic: A favored eunuch who knew the empress dowager's secret intent said to Rui, "Since the empress dowager's wish is already thus, why should Your Highness stubbornly oppose it?

literal: " Rui said, "Affairs of state and family are weighty — I would not shrink even from death; if I clung to life and sought safety, letting the state fall into turmoil, that is not my intent.
idiomatic: " Rui said, "Affairs of state and family are weighty — I would not shrink even from death; if I clung to life and sought safety, letting the state fall into turmoil, that is not my intent.

literal: Moreover I received the late emperor's testament — the trust placed in me is no light matter.
idiomatic: Moreover I received the late emperor's testament — the trust placed in me is no light matter.

literal: The succeeding ruler is young and tender — how can an evil minister be kept at his side?
idiomatic: The succeeding ruler is young and tender — how can an evil minister be kept at his side?

literal: If I do not uphold what is right, with what face can I look up to Heaven?
idiomatic: If I do not uphold what is right, with what face can I look up to Heaven?

literal: " He thereupon pressed his argument again, his words earnest and forceful.
idiomatic: " He thereupon pressed his argument again, his words earnest and forceful.

literal: The empress dowager ordered wine poured and granted to Rui.
idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered wine poured and granted to Rui.

literal: Rui with stern countenance said, "We are now discussing great affairs of state — this is not for a cup of wine!
idiomatic: Rui with stern countenance said, "We are now discussing great affairs of state — this is not for a cup of wine!

literal: " When he finished speaking he went out at once.
idiomatic: " When he finished speaking he went out at once.
